description: Test suite for category-related UI functionalities in a note-taking application, including adding, renaming, moving, and deleting categories, as well as interaction with UI elements like context menus and category lists.

methods.name: defaultInit
methods.description: Initializes the testing environment, likely setting up test state or navigating to the default application view.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Adds a new category with the specified name.

methods.name: assertCategoryDoesNotExist
methods.description: Verifies that a category with the given name does not exist.

methods.name: assertCategoryExists
methods.description: Verifies that a category with the specified name exists.

methods.name: assertCategoryOptionsOpened
methods.description: Checks if the category options (context menu) are currently open.

methods.name: assertCategoryOrder
methods.description: Asserts the position/order of a specified category in the list.

methods.name: navigateToCategory
methods.description: Navigates to the specified category view.

methods.name: selectMoveToCategoryOption
methods.description: Selects the option to move a note to a specified category.

methods.name: startEditingCategory
methods.description: Enables editing mode for a category.

methods.name: renameCategory
methods.description: Renames a category from an old name to a new name.

methods.name: defocusCategory
methods.description: Removes focus from the category, ending editing mode.

methods.name: moveCategory
methods.description: Changes the position of a category within the list.

methods.name: openCategoryContextMenu
methods.description: Opens the context menu (right-click menu) for a category.

methods.name: clickCategoryOptionRename
methods.description: Simulates clicking the 'Rename' option in the category's context menu.

methods.name: clickCategoryOptionDelete
methods.description: Simulates clicking the 'Delete' option in the category's context menu.

methods.name: collapseCategoryList
methods.description: Collapses or hides the category list UI element.

methods.name: assertCategoryListExists
methods.description: Checks if the category list is currently visible.

methods.name: assertCategoryListDoesNotExists
methods.description: Checks that the category list is not visible.

methods.name: navigateToNotes
methods.description: Navigates back to the 'All Notes' view or folder.

methods.name: assertCurrentFolderOrCategory
methods.description: Verifies the current folder or category view.

methods.name: assertNoteListLengthEquals
methods.description: Ensures the note list contains a specific number of notes.

methods.name: clickNoteOptions
methods.description: Open options menu for notes.

methods.name: createXUniqueNotes
methods.description: Creates a specified number of unique notes.
